flows.name: Order Submission, Matching & Trade Execution
flows.description: Submits orders through ingress and Trade UI to Order API, matches contra orders in Order Matcher, and publishes fills over NATS to Trade Processor.

transitions.description: Operator opens Trade UI via ingress.
Ingress serves Trade UI order entry workflow.
Trade UI submits order lifecycle request to Order API.
Order API routes eligible order to Order Matcher.
Order Matcher publishes execution fills to NATS.
Trade Processor books matched execution fills.
